2610.08716.title: Disentangling Paradigm, Identifier, and Decoding in Generative Retrieval
2610.08716.paper_summary: Generative retrieval trains a language model to generate the identifier of a relevant document. Recent work replaces the autoregressive decoder with diffusion, but changes identifiers, training recipe and decoding at once, so differences cannot be credited to the paradigm. On NQ320K and MS300K, we train autoregressive, masked-diffusion and block-diffusion models with residual-quantised, product-quantised and random identifiers. With identifier length and training budget fixed, we decode each model in several ways. Decoding alone moves a diffusion model's Hit@1 by 6.6 to 13.7 points. Our reference diffusion decoding, generate-and-match, generates an identifier, then retrieves the closest corpus identifiers. The generated identifier is right for 14-21% of NQ320K queries. We test one-pass scoring to decode diffusion retrievers: the model reads a fully masked identifier once, and each document is scored by its codes' probabilities. It matches or beats generate-and-match in 11 of 12 settings. Autoregressive models still lead in Hit@1; on NQ320K, the lead comes from the model, not beam search. Starting from one sampled identifier, one-pass scoring removes 46-83% of masked diffusion's deficit to beam search; from generate-and-match, at most a quarter. On NQ320K, every paradigm largely memorises which identifier answers which query: random identifiers keep 83-90% of the Hit@1 of residual-quantised ones. There, product-quantised identifiers lead residual-quantised ones by 3.4 points in the autoregressive model and by -0.7 to +3.6 in diffusion models; across decodings, AR's gap exceeds diffusion's by 1.5-2.3 points, around our 2-point threshold. Paradigm comparisons must report each paradigm at its own recipe and best decoding.
2610.08716.paper_summary_zh: 生成檢索訓練語言模型以生成相關文件的標識符。最近的研究用擴散取代了自回歸解碼器，但同時改變了標識符、訓練配方和解碼，因此無法將差異歸因於該範式。在 NQ320K 和 MS300K 上，我們訓練了自回歸、掩碼擴散和區塊擴散模型，使用殘差量化、產品量化和隨機標識符。在固定標識符長度和訓練預算的情況下，我們以多種方式解碼每個模型。僅解碼就使擴散模型的 Hit@1 提高了 6.6 到 13.7 分。我們的參考擴散解碼，生成並匹配，生成一個標識符，然後檢索最接近的語料庫標識符。生成的標識符對 14-21% 的 NQ320K 查詢是正確的。我們測試了一次性打分來解碼擴散檢索器：模型一次讀取一個完全掩碼的標識符，然後根據其代碼的概率對每個文檔進行打分。在 12 種設置中，它在 11 種情況下與生成並匹配相匹配或超越。自回歸模型在 Hit@1 上仍然領先；在 NQ320K 上，這一領先來自模型，而不是束搜索。從一個採樣的標識符開始，一次性打分消除了 46-83% 的掩碼擴散對束搜索的赤字；來自生成並匹配的，最多為四分之一。在 NQ320K 上，每個範式在很大程度上記住了哪個標識符回答了哪個查詢：隨機標識符保持了殘差量化標識符 83-90% 的 Hit@1。在那裡，產品量化標識符在自回歸模型中比殘差量化標識符領先 3.4 分，在擴散模型中則領先 -0.7 到 +3.6；在各種解碼中，自回歸的差距超過擴散的 1.5-2.3 分，約在我們的 2 分閾值附近。範式比較必須報告每個範式在其自身配方和最佳解碼下的表現。
